subject: SVG score chart: 2 design gaps to fix
body:
Audited buildChart() SVG (index.html lines 458-599). FD design is solid. Two gaps:

1. ACCESSIBILITY: SVG has no role or aria-label. Screen readers see nothing.
   Fix: Add role='img' and aria-label to the SVG element. Example:
   '<svg role="img" aria-label="Score progress chart showing ' + n + ' tests" viewBox...'

2. LEGEND: Chart shows two lines (first attempt = white, Run It Back = green dashed) but no label tells Kai which is which. If Kai takes a second attempt, both lines appear with no legend.
   Fix: Add a 2-item legend below the chart, visible only when ribXs.length > 0. Use text elements inside SVG or a small HTML div below #trendChartContainer.
   Labels: 'First try' (white dot) and 'Run It Back' (green dashed line icon).
   Max 2 words each — ADHD spec.

3. (Minor, no action needed) x-axis label font-size=10 is small on mobile but acceptable given viewBox scaling.
